title: Three Terms and One Short Pen
subtitle: 书写表达 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 书写表达（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：书写表达（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：handwriting　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 handwriting 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the teacher ① studied the handwriting that no examiner in the school would have described, and he said the studying was the whole of the term. The ② handwriting, meaning the script itself and not the pen, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; handwriting, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of handwriting in that school had the same short pen beside it, and the ④ handwriting at the far page, meaning the hand they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Handwriting, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the handwriting was the whole of the matter, meaning the signature and not the script. The ⑥ handwriting, meaning the signature and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; handwriting, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a script and a signature. He said the signature is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ handwriting had become a line in a copybook, and the copybook had become an argument about the short pen. The ⑧ handwriting of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one school and three terms of describing; handwriting, he said, is either the hand at the far page or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ handwriting I remember is the hand described in the copybook, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ handwriting, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being described; every handwriting, she said, is a signature that has agreed to look like a script. She said the signature was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 笔迹；书法（指学校里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 笔迹；书写（指那些字迹本身，与钢笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the handwriting 研究笔迹
D. n. 字迹（指留给孩子们学着临摹的那一手）
E. n. 书写（抽象总称，指一所学校的书写之事）
F. n. 笔迹（指习字本里写到、被记下的那一手）
G. n. 手书；亲笔（指一件事里人人都认却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手泽（抽象总称，指人人都认却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studied the handwriting that no examiner in the school would have described
The handwriting, meaning the script itself and not the pen
Every kind of handwriting in that school
the handwriting at the far page
the handwriting was the whole of the matter
the handwriting had become a line in a copybook
The handwriting of the whole thing
A handwriting, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: study the handwriting 意为“研究笔迹”，1971 年那位老师研究了学校里没有一位考官肯描述的笔迹。
handwriting 意为“笔迹、书写”，指那些字迹本身而不是钢笔，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
handwriting 意为“笔迹、书法”，指学校里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支矮矮的笔。
handwriting 意为“字迹”，指最远那页上留给孩子们学着临摹的那一手，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
handwriting 意为“手书、亲笔”，指一件事里人人都认却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份亲笔就是那件事的全部。
handwriting 意为“手泽”，指人人都认却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些笔迹，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
handwriting 意为“笔迹”，指习字本里写到、被记下的那一手，到 1976 年这一手成了习字本里的一行。
handwriting 意为“书写”，老师十一月写道，整件事的书写之事是一所学校和三个学期的描述。
handwriting 意为“笔迹”，我记得的是习字本里描述过的那一手，1978 年练成了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一手。
handwriting 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，笔迹是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的书写。
